$comment: The command-line tools FRIDAY leans on to run, test, search, unpack and convert for the owner. scripts/prefetch-toolkit.cjs installs the portable ones into <FRIDAY folder>/runtime before the EXE is built; anything at or above maxPrefetchBytes, or that needs an administrator or a restart, stays in the Install Manager.

prefetch.why: fast text search across a project
read and reshape JSON on the command line
read and reshape YAML on the command line
fast build runner for C and C++ projects
fast Python packages and virtual environments
convert and inspect audio and video

deferred.reason: administrator, WSL 2 and a restart; over 2 GB installed
Windows optional feature: administrator and a restart
needs a virtual machine; install when Docker is not wanted
PyTorch makes it larger than 2 GB
larger than 2 GB and needs a matching GPU driver
